quote: Implementing the Serializable interface without also implementing __serialize() and __unserialize() has been deprecated.
reason: A class declaration shows it; reported for a non-abstract class that names Serializable itself and has no parent or trait that could supply the new methods, while Serializable reached through another interface or a parent (runtime.serializable_inherited) is not seen in one file.

quote: Implicit conversion of floats to integers that result in loss of precision, e.g. a truncation from 1.9 to 1, is deprecated.
reason: Only a fractional float literal written as an array key or as an operand of % | & ^ << >> ~ is visible in the source; a float held in a variable, passed to an int parameter or used as an offset is runtime-only (runtime.float_to_int_precision_loss), and floats too large for an int are left out because 8.5 raises a warning instead.

quote: Calling a static method or accessing a static property directly on a trait is deprecated.
reason: Name::method() and Name::$property are reported when the same file declares Name as a trait; a trait from another file cannot be told from a class, and callables naming the trait raise nothing on any runtime.

quote: Returning a non-array from __sleep will raise a warning
reason: Depends on the value __sleep() returns; the runtimes show a notice on 7.4 and the warning already from 8.0, never a deprecation, with the same output on every version, so there is nothing to claim for 8.1.

quote: Returning by reference from a void function is deprecated.
reason: A declaration: function &name(): void, also for methods, closures, abstract and interface methods; raised at compile time.

quote: Automatic conversion of "false" into an empty array on write operands is deprecated.
reason: Whether the variable holds false when it is written to as an array is known only at run time; null still converts silently.

quote: Passing a non-string value to ctype_*() functions is deprecated.
reason: Reported when the single argument is written as an int or float literal, an (int) or (float) cast, true, false, null, or a call to intval(), strlen() or count(); an argument in a variable is runtime-only (runtime.ctype_non_string).

quote: The date_sunrise() and date_sunset() functions have been deprecated in favor of date_sun_info().
reason: data/catalog/functions.php lists date_sunrise and date_sunset as deprecated in 8.1, verified.

quote: The strftime() and gmstrftime() functions have been deprecated in favor of date()/DateTime::format() (for locale-independent formatting) or IntlDateFormatter::format() (for locale-dependent formatting).
reason: data/catalog/functions.php lists strftime and gmstrftime as deprecated in 8.1, verified.

quote: The FILTER_SANITIZE_STRING and FILTER_SANITIZE_STRIPPED filters have been deprecated.
reason: data/catalog/constants.php lists both constants as deprecated in 8.1, verified.

quote: The filter.default ini setting is deprecated.
reason: An INI setting that code cannot change: ini_set( 'filter.default', ... ) returns false and raises nothing on every runtime.

quote: The $num_points parameter of image(open|filled)polygon has been deprecated.
reason: A call to imagepolygon(), imageopenpolygon() or imagefilledpolygon() with four arguments shows it; no automatic fix because PHP 7.4 rejects the three-argument form.

quote: The mhash(), mhash_keygen_s2k(), mhash_count(), mhash_get_block_size() and mhash_get_hash_name() functions are deprecated.
reason: None of the runtimes is built with mhash (function_exists( 'mhash' ) is false on all seven), so nothing could be shown.

quote: The NIL constant has been deprecated.
reason: The imap extension is in none of the runtimes (NIL is not defined on any of them).

quote: Calling IntlCalendar::roll() with bool argument is deprecated.
reason: The intl extension is in none of the runtimes (IntlCalendar does not exist), and the call is a method on a variable of unknown class.

quote: Calling mb_check_encoding() without an argument is deprecated.
reason: A call with no argument, or with a literal null, shows it.

quote: The mysqli_driver::$driver_version property has been deprecated.
reason: The runtimes confirm the deprecation, but $object->driver_version is a property read on a variable whose class the syntax tree does not show.

quote: Calling mysqli::get_client_info in OO style or passing $mysqli argument to mysqli_get_client_info() function has been deprecated.
reason: mysqli_get_client_info() with an argument is reported; $link->get_client_info() is a method on a variable of unknown class and is not (runtime.mysqli_get_client_info_method).

quote: The mysqli::init() method has been deprecated.
reason: parent::init() inside a class that extends mysqli is reported; $link->init() on a variable of unknown class is not (runtime.mysqli_init_method).

quote: The INI directive oci8.old_oci_close_semantics has been deprecated.
reason: An INI directive of the oci8 extension, which none of the runtimes has.

quote: odbc_result_all() has been deprecated.
reason: The odbc extension is in none of the runtimes (function_exists( 'odbc_result_all' ) is false on all seven).

quote: The PDO::FETCH_SERIALIZE mode has been deprecated.
reason: Reported where PDO::FETCH_SERIALIZE is written in an argument of fetchAll(), setFetchMode() or query(), the calls the runtimes showed to raise the notice; reading the constant elsewhere raises nothing and a mode kept in a variable is not followed.

quote: Not passing the connection argument to PgSQL functions and using the default connection is deprecated.
reason: The pgsql extension is in none of the runtimes (function_exists( 'pg_query' ) is false on all seven).

quote: The ssl_method option for the SoapClient constructor has been deprecated in favor of ssl stream context options.
reason: Reported when 'ssl_method' is a key of an array literal passed as the options of new SoapClient(); options built in a variable, or a subclass of SoapClient, are not followed (runtime.soap_ssl_method_variable).

quote: Calling key(), current(), next(), prev(), reset(), or end() on objects is deprecated.
reason: Reported when the argument is certainly an object: $this for all six functions, and an (object) cast or new for key() and current(); any other variable is runtime-only (runtime.array_pointer_on_object).

quote: The strptime() function has been deprecated.
reason: data/catalog/functions.php lists strptime as deprecated in 8.1, verified.

quote: The auto_detect_line_endings ini setting has been deprecated.
reason: ini_set() or ini_alter() with the literal name and a literal value that switches it on raises the notice; switching it off or reading it raises nothing, and a setting in php.ini is outside the code.

quote: The FILE_BINARY and FILE_TEXT constants are deprecated.
reason: data/catalog/constants.php lists FILE_BINARY and FILE_TEXT as deprecated in 8.1, verified.
